title: VTC Install Claim Passkey Finish — payload
description: Complete first-administrator enrolment with a passkey: submit the WebAuthn registration, from whose credential public key — Ed25519 or P-256 — the administrator's did:key is derived, and receive a setup-session token. The passkey ceremony of vtc/install/claim/finish 0.2, widened from Ed25519 alone to P-256. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

installToken.description: The install JWT the claim was started with.

webauthnResponse.description: RegisterPublicKeyCredential from navigator.credentials.create() (opaque here). Its credential public key is a COSE key for EdDSA/Ed25519 (alg -8) or ES256/P-256 (alg -7); any other is refused with unsupportedAlgorithm.

Response.title: VTC Install Claim Passkey Finish — response payload

adminDid.description: The administrator's DID: the did:key of the passkey credential's own public key — Ed25519 (multicodec 0xed01, did:key:z6Mk…) or P-256, compressed (multicodec 0x1200, did:key:zDn…). Derived by the community from the registered key, never taken from the install token.

setupSessionToken.description: EdDSA JWT (aud=vtc-install-session, 5min TTL) consumed by admin/bootstrap.
